name: pci_transmit_message_9_immobilizer_command
comment: PCI TX[9] 4F 10 payload byte 1: secret-key frame number - 1 = key bytes 0-2 follow / 2 = key bytes 3-4 follow (was j1939_msg_slot_u_eeprom_cmd) (Medium confidence)

name: pci_transmit_message_9_immobilizer_data_1
comment: PCI TX[9] 4F 10 payload byte 2: immobilizer secret-key byte 0 (0x3fee2c) in frame 1 / byte 3 (0x3fee2f) in frame 2 (was j1939_msg_slot_u_eeprom_data0) (Medium confidence)

name: pci_transmit_message_9_immobilizer_data_2
comment: PCI TX[9] 4F 10 payload byte 3: immobilizer secret-key byte 1 (0x3fee2d) in frame 1 / byte 4 (0x3fee30) in frame 2 (was j1939_msg_slot_u_eeprom_data1) (Medium confidence)

name: pci_transmit_message_9_immobilizer_data_3
comment: PCI TX[9] 4F 10 payload byte 4: immobilizer secret-key byte 2 (0x3fee2e) in frame 1 / 0 in frame 2 (was j1939_msg_slot_u_eeprom_data2) (Medium confidence)

name: immobilizer_failure_seen_flag
comment: Set (cleared only at power-up) when - after the authorization window with a valid key or a latch set - PCI 0xB1 status bit 1 (SKIS failure per DRB) is on at the governor setpoint; it or EEPROM latch byte 0x3fee31 blocks the immobilizer fuel disable (was governor_cal_write_active_flag) (Medium confidence)

name: protection_pid_error_term
comment: protection PID error term (delta setpoint)

name: governor_pressure_solenoid_read_back_fault_latched_flag
comment: Set by cm848_debounceOutputReadBackFaults when the governor pressure solenoid read-back fault (output_read_back_fault_bits.governor_pressure_solenoid) outlasts its debounce and P0748 (fault 351) is set; no other code refers to it and there is no retest - so the check stops until the next power-up (was j1939_protection_receive_active_flag)

name: injection_timing_pilot_offset_barometric_pressure_angle
comment: Output of rpm x total_injection_quantity table injection_timing_pilot_offset_barometric_pressure_angle_grid
column5: multiplied by the unnamed Q12 factor at 0x40b964 (1-D table of the barometric pressure copy 0x3fd168) / 4096 into component 4. (was injection_timing_arb_comp4_rpm_factor) | earlier note: RPM factor for injection timing arb component 4

name: injection_timing_pilot_offset_intake_temperature_angle
comment: Output of rpm x total_injection_quantity table injection_timing_pilot_offset_intake_temperature_angle_grid
column5: multiplied by the unnamed Q12 factor at 0x40b96a (1-D table of the intake manifold temperature copy 0x3fd16c) / 4096 into component 3. (was injection_timing_arb_comp3_rpm_factor) | earlier note: RPM factor for injection timing arb component 3

name: injection_timing_pilot_offset_coolant_angle
comment: Output of rpm x total_injection_quantity table injection_timing_pilot_offset_coolant_angle_grid
column5: multiplied by the unnamed Q12 coolant factor at 0x40b972 / 4096 into injection_timing_pilot_offset_coolant_component; an angle
column6: not an rpm factor. (was injection_timing_coolant_trim_rpm_factor) | earlier note: RPM factor for injection timing coolant trim

name: injection_timing_pilot_offset_boost_angle
comment: Output of rpm x total_injection_quantity table injection_timing_pilot_offset_boost_angle_grid
column5: multiplied by the unnamed Q12 factor at 0x40b980 (rpm x cm848_calculateBoostPressure() grid) / 4096 into component 5. (was injection_timing_arb_comp5_rpm_factor_a) | earlier note: RPM factor A for injection timing arb component 5

name: thermostat_monitor_minimum_fuel_to_fail

name: thermostat_monitor_maximum_fuel_to_pass
comment: Fuel since start allowed for coolant to reach 170 F and pass the thermostat monitor = thermostat_monitor_coolant_rise_needed x 320 / (0x409fc2 + 0x409fc4 = 3840) - more is a P0128 failure (was cssc_oiltemp_state_update_time_threshold) (Medium confidence)

name: pci_transmit_message_2_timer_previous
comment: pci_transmit_message_2_timer from the last immobilizer task pass; below it = PCI TX[2] header 0x35 was just sent - then with the challenge sent and a key response received authorization flag bit 2 is set (was DAT_003fcfd5)

name: pci_receive_message_12_timer_previous
comment: pci_receive_message_12_timer from the last immobilizer task pass; the timer below it means a new PCI 0xB1 frame arrived (reset to 0 on reception) so cm848_processImmobilizerStatusMessage runs (was DAT_003fcfd7)

name: immobilizer_handshake_status_flags_snapshot
comment: Copy of immobilizer_handshake_status_flags stored after each PCI 0xB1 immobilizer status frame; write-only - no code or SCI table reads it (was DAT_003fcfd9)

name: temperature_rationality_intake_manifold_temperature_sample
comment: Intake manifold air temperature snapshot (1/64 deg F) copied each cycle for the cold-start cross-checks - its outlier vs coolant and battery feeds P0111 (word 22 bit 6) - 4th of the 4 snapshots at 0x3fd230-0x3fd236 (was DAT_003fd236)

name: sensor_stuck_check_enable_flag_previous
comment: Previous-cycle copy of the stuck-check enable flag - the stuck check uses it to initialise its state and snapshot on the first enabled pass (was DAT_003fd24a)

name: temperature_rationality_baseline_latched_flag
comment: One-shot guard - set the first qualifying cranking cycle after the coolant baseline and start battery temp are latched so they are captured only once (was DAT_003fd256)

name: datalink_broadcast_enable_default_cal
comment: Cummins JCBCFG Broadcast_Flags - datalink broadcast power-up default (same bit map as datalink_broadcast_enable_flags); EEPROM 0x3ee = 0x0000 in this truck's image so both J1939 periodic queues start disabled (was DAT_003fd870)

name: pci_normal_transmit_disabled_initial_cal
comment: EEPROM-shadowed (EEPROM offset 0x45c; 0 in dump) - boot value of pci_normal_transmit_disabled

name: pci_receive_processing_disabled_initial_cal
comment: EEPROM-shadowed (EEPROM offset 0x45d; 0 in dump) - boot value of pci_receive_processing_disabled

name: trip_average_fuel_economy
comment: Trip average fuel economy (EEPROM 0x8f2) = trip distance pulses x 13603 x 8 / (trip_fuel_used x 8000) - 0.1 mpg per count (reproduces the stored 94 / 90); zeroed by a trip reset

name: active_dtc_slot_list
comment: Fault slot numbers (index into obd_dtc_code_table) of the faults present now (count active_dtc_count / max 31); J1939 DM1 and the 0xB0 cluster DTC display read it first; dump holds slots 115 / 100 = P0633 / P0483 (was DAT_003fe05b)

name: previously_active_dtc_slot_list
comment: Fault slot numbers (index into obd_dtc_code_table) of faults that were present and have cleared (count previously_active_dtc_count / max 31); J1939 DM2 reads it and the 0xB0 cluster DTC display shows it after the active list (was DAT_003fe07b)

name: immobilizer_secret_key_byte_3
comment: Byte 3 of the 5-byte immobilizer secret key at EEPROM-mirror 0x3fee2c-0x3fee30 (EEPROM 0x19aa-0x19ae) - the other four bytes keep the boot ROM names of their time-shared rows (eeprom_write_buffer tail / eeprom_config_write_triggered_flag / flash2_operation_active_flag) (was DAT_003fee2f)

name: lifetime_time_at_governed_speed
comment: Lifetime passes with engine_at_governed_speed_flag set (EEPROM 0x19da) - probably idle time

name: temperature_rationality_coolant_soak_reference
comment: Persistent coolant reference (EEPROM mirror offset 0x1a34 - 1/64 deg F) - the cranking cross-check requires this minus current coolant over 0x409fac plus coolant below 0x409fb6 plus engine-off over 480 to confirm a cold soak - no _cal (runtime value) (was DAT_003feeb6) (Medium confidence)

name: immobilizer_authorization_window_limit
comment: Immobilizer task passes allowed for key authorization before cm848_runImmobilizerTask disables fuel - 20 in the RAM dump (was DAT_00408960)

name: mil_engine_off_start_tick
comment: Boot copy of ROM 0x6e57e: builder pass from which the MIL is forced on while the engine is not running (cold_start_phase 1 or 8) and the blink window opens; 150 = ~15 s (was DAT_00408964)

name: dtc_display_step_period_ticks
comment: Boot copy of ROM 0x6e580: DTC display step period in builder passes; 0 (this build) = step instead when the 0x2D lamp bit 0x02 is clear after pass 12 (was DAT_00408966)

name: mil_blink_end_tick
comment: Boot copy of ROM 0x6e582: end of the engine-off MIL blink window (on 5 / off 5 passes); 50 is below mil_engine_off_start_tick (150) so the blink never runs in this build (was DAT_00408968)

name: mil_blink_inhibit_fault_pending_value
comment: Boot copy of ROM 0x6e584 (0xFFFFB41E): fault_pending_flags value that stops the engine-off MIL blink; fault_pending_flags holds monitor-incomplete bits (bit 8 = OBD PID 1 misfire incomplete) so this is probably the readiness flash (was DAT_0040896a) (Medium confidence)

name: engine_to_vehicle_speed_ratio_high_threshold
comment: ROM constant 2400 = 300 rpm per mph (8 counts per rpm per mph): engine_to_vehicle_speed_ratio_filtered above it below 44 mph with a stable ratio and fuel demand above 8 sets engine_to_vehicle_speed_ratio_high_flag (was DAT_00408a60) (Medium confidence)
EMA filter coefficient: the weight of the previous value in 1/65536 (0 = no filtering) - ema_filter_state_t_003fcece.coefficient points here

name: vehicle_speed_pulse_timeout_reload
comment: Pulse timeout reload value (25)

name: transmission_temperature_check_minimum_engine_off_time
comment: 200 (minutes inferred): cm848_checkTransmissionTemperatureSensorPerformance can fail only when engine_off_time_at_key_on is at least this or the PCI 0x42 time is missing or flagged stuck (fault word 19 bit 4) (was DAT_00408d56) (Medium confidence)

name: rail_pressure_check_minimum_engine_off_time
comment: 480 (8 h if minutes): hpcr_checkRailPressureSensorBeforeStart aborts (reason 1) when the raw PCI 0x42 engine-off time is below this (was DAT_00409ef6) (Medium confidence)

name: temperature_rationality_cranking_start_delay
comment: Cranking cycles the scheduler waits before the temperature cross-check starts sampling - 49 - if the engine leaves cranking first the checks abort (was DAT_00409f92)

name: temperature_cross_check_minimum_engine_off_time
comment: 480 (8 h if minutes): cm848_crossCheckTemperatureSensorsBeforeStart aborts when engine_off_time_at_key_on is below this (was DAT_00409f94) (Medium confidence)

name: intake_manifold_temperature_cranking_outlier_threshold
comment: Deviation (1/64 deg F) the intake manifold air temp snapshot must exceed vs coolant and vs battery in the cranking outlier block - 640 = 10 F - widened to 0x409fae when intake_air_heater_status_flags bit 0 is clear (was DAT_00409fa0) (Medium confidence)

name: battery_temperature_rationality_mismatch_count_threshold
comment: Mismatch count above which the battery temp path is flagged (P0514) - 0 so the first mismatch triggers - shared by the cranking cross-check and the moving re-check (was DAT_00409fa4)

name: temperature_rationality_confirm_coolant_drop_threshold
comment: Coolant fall limit (1/64 deg F) for the governor-setpoint confirm - 320 = 5 F - P0111 is set when the latched baseline minus the tracked coolant minimum stays under this - a larger fall aborts (was DAT_00409faa)

name: temperature_rationality_coolant_soak_drop_threshold
comment: Minimum coolant fall from the stored soak reference for the cranking cross-check to run - 0 so current coolant must simply be below the reference (was DAT_00409fac) (Medium confidence)

name: intake_manifold_temperature_cranking_outlier_threshold_wide
comment: Wider intake manifold outlier tolerance (1/64 deg F) - 1600 = 25 F - used instead of 0x409fa0 when intake_air_heater_status_flags bit 0 is clear - that flag is intake-air-heater status not battery voltage (was DAT_00409fae) (Medium confidence)

name: intake_manifold_temperature_cranking_mismatch_count_threshold
comment: Cranking mismatch count above which the intake manifold air temp path is flagged pending (P0111) - 0 so the first mismatch triggers (was DAT_00409fb0)

name: temperature_rationality_cranking_decision_count
comment: Cranking cycle count at which the temperature cross-check makes its decision - 50 (was DAT_00409fb2)

name: temperature_rationality_confirm_dwell_limit
comment: Sample count for the governor-setpoint confirm stage - 300 - the coolant minimum is tracked for this many samples before the P0111 decision (was DAT_00409fb4)

name: temperature_rationality_cranking_coolant_maximum
comment: Current coolant must be below this (1/64 deg F) for the cranking cross-check to run - 12800 = 200 F (was DAT_00409fb6) (Medium confidence)

name: etc2_actual_gear_ratio
comment: J1939 ETC2 (PGN 61445) bytes 2-3 actual gear ratio (SPN 526 - 0.001 per bit) clamped to at least 100; set by the ETC2 receive handler at 0x22c5c; x 2048 / 1000 = drivetrain_ratio_raw in cm848_calculateDrivetrainRatioFromGearRatio (was DAT_0040a2aa)

name: pci_receive_message_4_status
comment: PCI RX[4] header 2D status: 0x10 timed out / 0x08 in-frame response error / 0x20 payload length mismatch / 0x01 0x02 0x04 0x40 completion error bits / 0x80 unconfirmed

name: pci_receive_message_7_payload
comment: PCI RX[7] header 0x63 payload (2 bytes): ABS lamp request broadcast per DRB (byte 1: bit 0 brake lamp / bit 1 ABS lamp / bit 2 traction control message / bit 3 traction control off lamp - byte 2 bit 1 traction control braking); no code reads it or its status or timer (was DAT_0040b404) (Medium confidence)

name: pci_receive_message_8_byte_3
comment: PCI RX[8] header 0x6C payload byte 3 - only tested for zero together with byte 2 in cm848_processPciRemoteFaultStatus (was DAT_0040b411)

name: pci_receive_message_8_byte_5
comment: PCI RX[8] header 0x6C payload byte 5 - only bit 5 is read: with bytes 2 and 3 nonzero and a reported fault it sets fault word 25 bit 4 (was DAT_0040b413)

name: pci_transmit_message_1_payload
comment: PCI TX[1] header 0x1E payload buffer: 7 bytes zeroed at power-up by cm848_initPciMessagePayloads but the length is 1 and nothing else writes it - the ECM sends 1E 00 every 352 timer units (was unnamed)

name: pci_transmit_message_4_status
comment: PCI TX[4] header D1 03 status: 0x10 timed out / 0x08 in-frame response error / 0x20 payload length mismatch / 0x01 0x02 0x04 0x40 completion error bits / 0x80 unconfirmed

name: pci_transmit_message_5_status
comment: PCI TX[5] header 53 status: 0x10 timed out / 0x08 in-frame response error / 0x20 payload length mismatch / 0x01 0x02 0x04 0x40 completion error bits / 0x80 unconfirmed

name: pci_receive_message_13_status
comment: PCI RX[13] header 92 status: 0x10 timed out / 0x08 in-frame response error / 0x20 payload length mismatch / 0x01 0x02 0x04 0x40 completion error bits / 0x80 unconfirmed

name: pci_transmit_message_16_air_conditioning_pressure

name: pci_transmit_message_17_byte_1

name: pci_transmit_message_19_payload

name: pci_transmit_message_21_payload

name: pci_transmit_message_22_payload

name: pci_transmit_message_23_payload

name: pci_transmit_message_24_payload

name: intake_manifold_temperature_stuck_check_state

name: ambient_air_temperature_stuck_check_state
comment: Per-sensor stuck-over-distance state for ambient air temp (slot 20) - 1 monitoring / 2 moved enough / 3 stuck (P0071) - the stuck check arg 16 for the slot-20 call (was DAT_0040ba2e)

name: water_in_fuel_sensor_filtered

name: cruise_switch_button_code
comment: sensor_channel_filtered_output[47]: decoded cruise switch button code (0-5 CRUISE_SWITCH_REQUEST) from the resistor-ladder lookup cruise_switch_button_code_table_y - debounced by protection_control_state_check_2 - 5 (IDLE) in the dump (was DAT_0040bb4e) (Medium confidence)

name: fuel_level_sensor_filtered
